purpose: Contract probes on ISLA (Invariant Slice Attention) prompted by the independent audit (audit.md items 2 and 12), measured before and after the repairs committed on 2026-09-08 (query_mass option, gauge-normalized local features, passive-decode option composition). Small random models on CPU; these are code-level contracts, not trained-checkpoint errors.

source_measure_refinement.construction: 60 random source tokens (positions scaled (3,2,1), unit normals, weights in [0.5,1.5]), 17 queries = first 17 source points, drive random; every source token replaced by two identical copies at half weight (same discrete measure). Readout: relative L2 change of the output. ISLA(hidden=32, n_layers=2, n_slices=8, similarity_gauge=True), float64.
source_measure_refinement.note: The default convention is unchanged so trained query-token checkpoints reproduce exactly; the dependence of the trained query-token+SDF checkpoint on companion-query count is measured separately (results/isla_qt_companion_dependence_2026-09-08.json when it lands).

similarity_gauge_plus_surface_local_feat.construction: Rescale geometry by k=2.7 with a shift; areas by k^2. Readout: max abs output difference after undoing the scale (float64).
similarity_gauge_plus_surface_local_feat.non_gauge_path: bit-identical before and after (the trained DrivAerML local-features arm used this path)

reproduced_failures: odd_head (source normals overwritten by query normals)
passive_decode_option_composition.after: all decode with distinct source/query counts (60/17), finite outputs, query independence at 1e-12; boundary scalars with distinct query points raise a ValueError (no query-side scalar exists)
passive_decode_option_composition.bit_identity_check: 11 configurations (plain, gauge, local features, local+boundary scalars, odd head with/without gauge, passive with local features / interior+gauge / anchors, query tokens, query tokens+SDF+local) bit-identical to HEAD before the repairs

bf16_equivariance_residual.construction: Default surface ISLA (hidden 64, 4 layers, 32 slices), 500-point anisotropic cloud, rigid rotation; relative output difference after rotating back, CPU.
bf16_equivariance_residual.reading: Equivariance is exact by algebraic construction; the finite-precision residual on the deployed bf16 path is a measured quantity of order 1e-2 on CPU autocast. The GPU trained-path residual has not been measured.
